principles: Truth-first handoff must use live lifecycle facts first
Preflight evidence must be machine-verifiable and bound to current HEAD/story lineage
Host behaviors should be deterministic across host types
Claims about completion must include proof provenance
drivers: Prevent stale-doc regressions across multi-host work
rationale: We need one evidence contract to avoid host drift and stale-doc misclassification, and to keep 3x2/2-host verification auditable.

preMortem.scenario: Host claims pending while story is DONE
preMortem.mitigation: Gate always resolves host claims against story_get/story_done facts before any pending suggestion

preMortem.scenario: Host outputs proof for stale memory evidence
preMortem.trigger: Session memory overrides canonical story facts
preMortem.mitigation: Memory evidence marked advisory only; strict host-preflight required

preMortem.scenario: Hosts accept missing/partial preflight as proof
preMortem.consequence: Silent false confidence and incomplete coverage
preMortem.mitigation: Explicit preflight verdict schema with blocked/no-block/uncertain and explicit winSignal
